events.text: Doctrine dictates taking the east crossing (F3) and offering a truce. Kite is in a truce. I'll move forces towards F3, using the plain order method as instructed. I need to push towards F3.

SECOND FOOT, MARCH TO EAST FORD.

events.text: My doctrine dictates taking F3 early. I must consolidate forces and secure F3 (East Ford). Tiger is strong at SE, and I have units near N-east/F3. I will move my archers/inf to secure F3 and send a decoy towards Tiger's known positions.

events.text: Doctrine dictates taking F1 early. I hold F1 with inf/arch. I need to reinforce/secure it. I will move my reserves to F1 to solidify the hold, as per doctrine.

events.text: It is Watch 6. My doctrine says take the east ford (F3) in the first 5 watches. I missed that window. I must secure F3 now. I will move my forces towards F3 and reinforce it, using the cipher method for all orders.
